Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident details, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were driving when the collision happened?
A: I was in Conroe, Texas, heading toward a shopping center on the north side of the main road. I was turning left into
the lot.
Q: What was the traffic like at the time?
A: Pretty steady. There was a car coming the other way, and I waited for it to pass. Then I saw a gap and started my
turn.
Q: Did you have a green light or a turn arrow?
A: It was a green light, but there was no arrow for left turns. I yielded to oncoming traffic beofre going.
Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle coming from the opposite direction hit the front passenger side of my car. I felt a hard jolt and my head
snapped forward and back.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did you hit your head on anything or lose consciousness?
A: No, I didn't lose consciousness. My head didn't hit anything, but my neck was really sore almost right away.
Q: Where are you feeling pain now?
A: My neck is stiff and it hurts when I turn to check my blind spot. My lower back is also aching, mostly when I sit for a
long time.
Q: Have you seen a doctor or received treatment?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same day, and I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?
A: Just that I was driving carefully and I'm trying to get back to normal. I'm still dealing with the pain every day.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Okay, thanks.
</page>

- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.
